correctness.rationale: The exact co-rotating linearization is a diagonal family of rank-two radial blocks plus rank-two collective coupling. The determinant lemma gives [lambda(lambda+2 beta)]^(M-2) times the explicit quartic. Angular and radial closure kernels both have dimension M-2 at noncollinear configurations, proving semisimplicity. Strict quartic Routh-Hurwitz inequalities prove transverse decay; the finite-dimensional normally attracting equilibrium manifold then has a stable foliation. P(0,q=1)=0 with partial_lambda P=2 beta h^2 and partial_(1-q^2) P=beta^2 h^2 proves the exact first-order slow-root coefficient -beta/2. Rational 8x8 characteristic polynomial, symbolic inequalities, and independent Jacobians at M=3,4,5,6,8 were executed using the embedded standalone checker. No finite test is used as infinite proof.
